title: Guestbook
intro: Visitors leave their name and a short note from their phone. A new note scrolls across the matrix at once, and every few minutes the book is read: its title, then the latest notes. In between the show plays. Names and notes go through a word filter, also the ones already in the book: a word added to the blocked list takes a note out. The book survives a restart. Pick the matrix, then Save.
